title: Onbadhule Guru
desc: On the eve of his wedding, Guru embarks on a wild adventure with his married friends. However, after a night of revelry, they wake up to find that Guru has vanished.

title: Adutha Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a dedicated college professor, works extensively in order to empower students to speak up against societal prejudices.

title: Vaikundapuram
desc: Bantu, a middle-class man, grows up being neglected by his cold-hearted father, Valmiki. However, his world is shaken when he learns that he has been switched at birth.

title: Captain Miller
desc: After seeing the atrocities of the Britishers, an Indian soldier, Easa, leaves the military services and conducts heists until he has to choose between running away or confronting the force.

title: Ellam Avan Seyal
desc: Advocate Laxman, who has his own unconventional methods of serving justice, takes up the case of a college girl who is found dead after a ragging session, and finds the shocking truth behind it.
